test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Although I have a lot of work to do, I am determined to finish it all by the end of the day so that I can enjoy my weekend __not having any imminent due dates__.

options.text: not with any pressure of due date

solution: The correct answer is** Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"a lot of work to do"** refers to having numerous tasks or responsibilities that need to be completed. (बहुत काम करना) • **Example:** She has a lot of work to do before the project deadline. • The phrase **"without any looming deadlines"** means not having any upcoming due dates that are causing pressure or stress. (बिना किसी आसन्न समय सीमा के) • **Example:** He finished his assignments early so he could relax **without any looming deadlines.** Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate **substitute** for the** underlined words** is **'without any looming deadlines'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: with no pending reservations** (बिना किसी लंबित आरक्षण के): This phrase means having no remaining concerns or doubts. • **Example:** She accepted the job offer with no pending reservations. • **Option 3: not leaving any work incomplete** (कोई भी काम अधूरा नहीं छोड़ना): This phrase means ensuring all tasks are completed. • **Example:** He worked late to ensure he was not leaving any work incomplete. • **Option 4: not with any pressure of due date** (समाप्ति तिथि के दबाव के बिना): This phrase means without feeling the stress of upcoming deadlines. • **Example:** She completed her tasks early, not with any pressure of due date. 4e:Tae0, The correct answer is **Option 1)**
